limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses cancer cell lines and pharmacological compounds, but Tahoe-100M is designed as a broadly applicable perturbation atlas for multiple tissues and contexts.

Cell line identity and cell cycle phase are major factors driving stratification; drug treatment and dose have a more modest effect, requiring differential expression analysis to delineate drug-induced changes.
Some cell lines (3 out of 50) had low abundance and were not evaluated in downstream analyses.

research_questions.statement: How does Tahoe-100M, a giga-scale single-cell perturbation atlas, enable context-dependent gene function and cellular modeling?

experiments_or_tasks: 17,813 unique cell line-drug conditions; 31-fold increase in perturbed conditions vs benchmark single-cell drug screen, 29-fold increase in observations per condition vs genetic perturbation screen.
379 distinct drugs, 180 classified into 25 MOAs, median 5 drugs per MOA. 69% are approved agents. Drugs target 325 genes, 120 targeted by >1 drug.
Characterization of 47 cell lines (out of 50) from 13 organs, with driver mutations (TP53, KRAS, CDKN2A in about half).

datasets.name: Tahoe-100M

evidence_spans.content: Mosaic platform uses spheroids of mixed cell lines, drug treatment for 24h, dissociation, fixation, Parse GigaLab kit, SNP deconvolution.

provenance.text_excerpt: We leveraged our Mosaic platform to measure the transcriptomic responses to drug treatments across a panel of 50 established and commercially-available cancer cell lines... cultured spheroids consisting of a mixture of cell lines in suspension and subjected each spheroid to individual treatments, including DMSO vehicle controls. After 24 hours of drug treatment, spheroids were dissociated, fixed, and profiled using the Parse GigaLab kit

experiments_or_tasks: 14 96-well plates of spheroids were seeded and drug treated. Barcoded single cells from each plate were pooled and distributed into sublibraries. Processed 72-165 sublibraries per plate, total 1,786 sublibraries. Obtained ~1.4 trillion raw sequencing reads representing 153 million cells. After filtering, 100.6 million cells pass minimal filters and 95.6 million cells pass full filters.

Mosaic platform: cultured spheroids consisting of a mixture of 50 cancer cell lines, subjected to drug treatments (including DMSO vehicle controls) for 24 hours, dissociated, fixed, and profiled using Parse GigaLab kit (combinatorial barcoding scRNA-seq). SNP-based deconvolution assigned cells to cell line of origin.

methods.name: Mosaic platform
methods.protocol_description: Spheroids of mixed 50 cancer cell lines cultured in suspension, treated with drugs or DMSO for 24h, dissociated, fixed, and profiled using Parse GigaLab kit for combinatorial barcoding scRNA-seq. SNP-based deconvolution for cell line assignment.

methods.name: scRNA-seq data processing
methods.protocol_description: Sequencing of sublibraries (72-165 per plate) from 14 plates, ~1.4 trillion raw reads, 153 million cells. Filtering criteria: minimal filters (100.6M cells) and full filters (95.6M cells).

experiments_or_tasks: Cell cycle phase analysis: Palbociclib enriches G1, Dinaciclib enriches G2/M; HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induce G2/M arrest.
